title: 第二章 过目不忘
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

老头懵逼了，怎么他儿子想一出是一出。

这个军校包国维是无论如何要去的，继续说道：“成绩单您也收到了，全是丁，就体育是我的强项，乙。

去军校正好能发挥我的长处。”

“当兵？太危险了。国维，你是我们老包家的独苗啊。”

他爹就想让包国维变成像高科长那样的人物。

“那个是陆军军官学校，军官学校，毕业了都是要当军官的，上了战场，会死很多人，但军官还是相对安全的，您老放心好了，我能照顾好自己。”

老包向来是做不了包国维的主的。又是叫爹又是您老的称呼，让他都不快认得这个儿子了。

并且听他这么说，或许也可以试试。

正好现在还犯愁学费呢，连志诚中学的制服费都凑不齐。

可是又想着去这个陆军军官学校又要花多少钱？“这个军校的学费？”

“报纸上说了，如果考上了是不要学费的，人家还会发放路费呢。”

“可要是没考上？”老包担心了，如果军校没考上，志诚中学也没去读了，这可怎么办。

“一定能考上的。”

若是没有外挂，包国维还担心自己会落选。但现在有过目不忘的能力再加上随身空间，想来不该有落选的可能。

很快到了新年。

秦府的人陆陆续续地都回来了。

秦老太爷也从上海回了小镇上，一时间好不热闹。

厨房里头也忙碌了起来。

现在的包国维一有点时间就看看各种带字的东西，过目不忘的能力是真好用。

在厨房里也晃荡了一下：“婶子，做什么好吃的呢，这么香。”

把秦府做菜的大娘都吓了一跳，包国维这已经多少年没叫过她婶子了，现在又冷不丁来了一嘴。

包国维在一旁看着她做干菜焖肉，记忆力极强，把所有做菜的顺序步骤都给记了下来。这干菜焖肉也是浙江的一道名菜。

这些天秦府讨论的话题不少都在包国维身上：“老包，你家国维真不念了，这已经念了十年的书，不念了，这不可惜了嘛。”

到了过年这天，秦府的人待人宽厚，有好些个人也留在府里过年。

The old man was confused, why did his son think so all the time?

Bao Guowei wanted to go to this military school no matter what, and continued: "You have also received the transcript. They are all D, and physical education is my strong point, B.

Going to the military academy would be a good way to utilize my strengths."

"Being a soldier? It's too dangerous. Guowei, you are the only child of our old Bao family."

His father wanted Bao Guowei to become someone like Section Chief Gao.

"That's the Army Military Academy, the military academy. After graduation, everyone will become an officer. On the battlefield, many people will die, but officers are relatively safe. Don't worry, I can take care of myself."

Lao Bao has never been able to be Bao Guowei's boss.Calling him daddy and your old name again made him almost recognize his son.

And to hear what he said, maybe you can give it a try.

It just so happens that I am still worried about tuition fees. I can't even pay for the uniform fees of Zhicheng Middle School.

But then I thought about how much it would cost to go to the Army Officer School?"The tuition for this military school?"

"The newspaper said that if you pass the exam, there will be no tuition fee, and they will also provide travel expenses."

"But what if I don't pass the exam?" Lao Bao was worried. What if he didn't pass the military school and didn't go to Zhicheng Middle School.

"I will definitely pass the exam."

Without plug-ins, Bao Guowei was worried that he would lose the election.But now that I have the ability of photographic memory and the space I carry with me, there should be no chance of losing the selection.

New Year's Day is coming soon.

People from the Qin Mansion came back one after another.

Old Mrs. Qin also returned to the town from Shanghai, and it was very lively for a while.

The kitchen was also busy.

Now Bao Guowei reads all kinds of things with words whenever he has some time. His photographic memory is really useful.

He also wandered around the kitchen for a while: "Auntie, what are you cooking for? It's so delicious."

The aunt who cooks in Qin's house was shocked. Bao Guowei hadn't called her aunt for many years, and now he called her aunt again.

Bao Guowei watched her cooking dried vegetables and stewed meat. He had a strong memory and memorized all the steps in the cooking sequence.This braised pork with dried vegetables is also a famous dish in Zhejiang.

Many of the topics discussed in the Qin Mansion these days are on Bao Guowei: "Old Bao, your family Guowei really doesn't want to study anymore. He has been studying for ten years. It would be a pity if he doesn't study anymore."

On the New Year's Day, the people in the Qin Mansion were generous to others, and many people stayed in the Mansion to celebrate the New Year.
